items.title: Jim Robinson Interview, 1961-07-13
items.q: Missouri on the trumpet, sitting on the planet.

ctx.x: I never heard much about that band, I don't think. Who was in the band other than Sidney Veen and Zooey? One of the time they had the band then.

Mm-hmm. I was just something I can call something, but it was uh, Aida, uh, boy Aida playing, what Aida, Aida? Aida Morris playing Trimor on. And uh, Arthur Hogan was playing drums. Zooey on the trumpet. And uh, Missouri on the trumpet, sitting on the planet. Let me see who was on the bass. Oh, it was a long time ago, Mark, man, I'm telling you. I don't see what I got. I don't know, I just remember who was on the band, you. It's been so long, you know. What about Jimmy Noon? Well, Jimmy Noon, uh, well he always…

All the, all the different places. Hood Be and the band. St. Catharines. Huh? St. Catharines. St. Catharines. St. Catharines and Hall. They played there. Uh, who'd be in the band with, uh, Noon and Oliver?
